summary: Iceberg community activity this week focused on specification enhancements and REST Catalog improvements, including proposals for relative paths in v4 spec, identifier uniqueness clarification, and optional labels field in LoadTableResponse. Concurrent discussions addressed TLS configuration defaults, column-level updates for ML/AI workloads, and patch release planning for versions 1.10.2 and 0.9.1.
highlights: REST Catalog spec clarifications: identifier uniqueness and 404 response documentation for /v1/config endpoint
V4 spec enhancements: relative paths support and Map<String, String> attributes field for manifest entries
TLS security discussion: HostnameVerificationPolicy default behavior (CLIENT vs BOTH) in TLSConfigurer
Efficient column updates exploration for ML/AI workloads with high-dimensional tables
